title: CS/N-CD composites enhance physical barriers, antioxidant activity and microbial modulation for improved chili pepper preservation
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, 13,327-339
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00743G, Paper
Jiayi Chen, Zhuang Cheng, Junyi Zhang, Zhemin Jia, Zhenggao Xiao, Le Yue, Zhenyu Wang
Eco-friendly CS/N-CD composites exert synergistic preservation effects via enhanced barrier, antioxidant and antibacterial properties, improving the microbial microenvironment of stored chili peppers (Capsicum annuum L.).
